gaps.hint: the standard verb with television and sport
gaps.explanation: 'Watch television' is the fixed collocation; 'look' needs 'at', and 'see television' is not used.

gaps.sentence: He is very ___ to criticism and takes it personally.
gaps.hint: easily affected or hurt; pattern: ___ to
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to something' means easily affected or upset by it; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.

gaps.sentence: The book gives a detailed ___ account of the period.
gaps.hint: connected with the study of the past
gaps.explanation: 'Historical' means relating to history or the past; 'historic' means important in history.

gaps.sentence: The government plans to ___ taxes next year.
gaps.hint: the verb takes an object: taxes
gaps.explanation: 'Raise' means to lift or increase something (takes an object); 'rise' means to go up (no object).
'Complement' means to combine well with or complete something; 'compliment' means to praise.

gaps.sentence: This smell ___ me of my childhood.
gaps.explanation: 'Remind somebody of something' means to make someone think of something; 'remember' is not followed by an object + of.

gaps.sentence: The ___ issue of the magazine has an interview with the president.
gaps.explanation: 'Current' means happening or existing now; 'actual' means real as opposed to possible or estimated.

gaps.sentence: He ___ her on her presentation and her handling of questions.
